answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits, through a polynomial identity commitment, to an evaluation point and value, binding its Semaphore identity in an RLN tree. Each message carries a zero-knowledge rate-limit proof and nullifier; duplicate use produces two Shamir shares that interpolate the private key, triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. Consequently, marble, meadow, and glacier identities cannot cheaply multiply.
